scope: Found during live authenticated Batch 2 build on 2026-10-28: the durable worker reached the universal engine, which refused with repository.read/repository.write missing because a Builder project has no attached GitHub repository. Grant those two authorities only when trusted server code has bound a Builder project to the run (the only write path is the injected builder commit).

keep: Authority is derived by the backend, never by model text or a request body
The builder commit is the only write path for a Builder project
extend: Universal capability authorities include repository read/write for a server-bound Builder run

schemaImpact.rollout: No SQL or schema change; enqueue_google_canonical_run already accepts any JSON object input.
schemaImpact.rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy the previous image. Queued deliveries without a builderProjectId are unaffected.

auth.description: No authentication change. The id is accepted only after the verified owner matches the durable project.

tenant.description: No tenant boundary change. The Builder binding is created only after ownership is resolved from the verified identity.

approval.description: Adds repository:read and repository:write authority for a Builder-bound run. The flag is set only by the pipeline when the server-resolved builder binding exists; it is never read from a request body, and writes can only go through the injected builder commit that saves a durable revision for the verified owner.

cost.description: No new spend path. Builds use the existing provider budget reservation.

tests.scope: Authority granted for a Builder-bound run; flag set only by the pipeline beside the builder commit; never read from a request body. 3 PASS.

architecture.reason: Extends the existing Google durable delivery input and the existing canonical worker. No second orchestrator, scheduler or control plane.

rollout: Merge after required checks, build the release image, update the API service and canonical Job together at the new SHA, then repeat the authenticated build.
rollback: Revert the commit and redeploy; restore the previous service revision and Job image/label.
knownGaps: Live end-to-end build proof is recorded only after deployment
Preview, QA and external delivery remain separate gates
placeholderClaimsRemaining: Batch 2 building is not accepted until a live authenticated build saves a revision

blockers: Release image build, Job and service update
